paragraphs: Elyashuv. Rabbi Abba ben Elyashuv—requires examination. Rabbi Yitzchak, son of Elyashuv (see there). When he died, thefts occurred, since through his merit there had been no thieves. (See Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elyashuv.)
